The Carlyle Group has made a total of 299 acquisitions. It has invested across 138 sectors, with Cybersecurity, Investment Tech, and GRC Software seeing the most activity, and expanded into 37 countries, notably the United States, United Kingdom, and Germany. Peak acquisition years were 2021 with 21 acquisitions, followed by 2017 and 2016 with 20 each. From 2020 to 2025, the company averaged 11 acquisitions per year, with 11 completed in the current calendar year. Its most recent acquisition is BauWatch, a Northampton-based provider of monitored temporary video surveillance for construction and property founded in 2010, which was acquired in September 2026.
